items.title: What Is Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Telling Investors With Its New Infant Formula?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) launched Similac 360 Total Care Made With Whole Milk, a commercially sterile ready-to-feed liquid infant formula made with whole milk in the U.S. The product is the first of its kind in the U.S. market to combine whole milk with a ready-to-feed liquid format. The formula uses whole milk and a blend of human milk oligosaccharides to more closely mirror key elements of breast milk.
